prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One complete existing DooKnow LOCAL component on neutral light-gray backdrop, not a full invented host page. Simplified Chinese, crisp natural-size controls, flat white/#f7f8fa, dark #272b3a/secondary#657084, thin #e6e9f1 lines, primary#4566c6,8px radii and restrained shadow. PILOT input is STYLE ONLY, no importing its rail/header/tree/content. Actual source templates determine all titles, field order, controls, permissions and selected state. No protocol requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, fabricated success/online states, team/AI/ToDoo features or OS/browser-dialog chrome. Secret data empty or masked only. One coherent selected condition; hidden alternatives remain hidden. Preserve header/close/body-scroll/footer actions and actual disabled guards; do not derive new disabled rules from API constraints.
SOURCE-DERIVED BLOG OWNER NOTE PICKER, exact local component (no matching picker runtime screenshot). Header existing small English eyebrow FROM YOUR KNOWLEDGE BASE, h2 选择一篇笔记, closeX with meaning关闭选稿. Exact intro 只添加博客选稿。原稿保持原样，发布由你确认。 Search input with magnifier, empty focused query and exact placeholder 搜索笔记名称或路径…. Ready state creating=false,error absent. Exactly two synthetic Markdown-note row BUTTONS, not checkboxes: row1 file icon, title示例手记, smallpath00-Inbox/示例手记.md, right existing badge已选稿; row2 fileicon, title记录与回顾, smallpath30-Knowledge/记录与回顾.md, right plusicon. These are isolated example notes only, no actual private records. No folder rows/PDF/diagrams or fabricated success message. Source footer lock icon and text 只有手动发布的文章，才会进入公开站点。 No extra 确认/完成/发布 button; choosing row creates draft or opens existing post. Existing close/backdrop/Escape focus behavior remains contract. Full bounded scrollable list and current component only, no public-blog/nav/owner rail.
